objective: Freeze the runtime-assurance register: the invariants the runtime claims, the fault acceptance matrix, and a gate that refuses a claim whose enforcement point or evidence no longer resolves.
acceptance: every ENFORCED invariant names an enforcement symbol and at least one test that resolve in the repository
every NOT_IMPLEMENTED invariant states a gap and cites no evidence
every required fault has exactly one acceptance case with a declared terminal state and a three-valued verdict
no fault case expects a confirmed goal verdict
the generated page is byte-identical to the document the register generates
an unresolvable scenario is refused before a runner starts and leaves no output directory
existing scenario, controller and CAN tests keep passing
a stale `.partial` staging directory from a killed run is removed by the next run, and a fresh one is left alone
no page in this slice claims a safety function, performance level or certification; the sayable column of the boundary page is gated
commands: python -m ruff check libs/kernel/workbench/kernel/assurance.py tools/scripts/check_assurance.py tests/unit/test_assurance_matrix.py tools/scripts/sim_cli.py
evidence: assurance gate output with invariant and acceptance-case counts
focused pytest output for the register, the gate and the admission guard
Task Packet and context validation output
stop_conditions: an interface enum or JSON Schema change is required
a new runtime state machine or a second stop path would be needed
a claim can only be satisfied by weakening an existing fail-closed test
a write outside allowed_paths is required
